translations.idiomatic: In 1287 he was a hundred-household of the Qipchaq Guard. Campaigning under Totoq against the rebel princes Shilieji and Nayan, he distinguished himself, received the golden tally, and was promoted to thousand-household.

sentences.zh: 從征忽剌出，戰于阿里台之地。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Hulachu and fought at the place of Alitai.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned against Hulachu and fought at Alitai.

sentences.zh: 元貞二年，以疾卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanzhen he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness in 1296.

sentences.zh: 子哈贊赤襲職，從創兀兒於魁烈兒之地，與哈荅安戰有功。

translations.literal: His son Hazanchi succeeded to the post; following Chuangwu'er at the place of Kuilier, he fought Hada'an with merit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hazanchi succeeded him. Following Chuangwu'er at Kuilier, he distinguished himself in battle against Hada'an.

sentences.zh: 大德五年，從戰杭海。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade he followed fighting at Hanghai.
translations.idiomatic: In 1301 he fought at Hanghai.

sentences.zh: 從武宗親征哈剌阿荅。

translations.literal: He followed Wuzong in personally campaigning against Hala A'da.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied Wuzong's personal campaign against Hala A'da.

sentences.zh: 復從創兀兒征不別、八憐，為前鋒，以功受賞賚。

translations.literal: Again he followed Chuangwu'er in campaigning against Bubie and Baling, served as vanguard, and for merit received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Chuangwu'er against Bubie and Baling as vanguard and was rewarded for his achievements.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，授金符，為千戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing he was granted the golden tally and made a thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: In 1313 he received the golden tally and was made a thousand-household.

sentences.zh: 明宗居潛邸，延祐四年命從西征，與禿滿帖木兒戰于失剌塔兒馬失之地，以功復受厚賞，居其地十五年。

translations.literal: When Mingzong dwelt in the latent residence, in the fourth year of Yanyou he was ordered to follow the western campaign; he fought Tudie Temur at the place of Shilata'er Mashi; for merit he again received generous reward and dwelt in that land fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: While Mingzong was still heir apparent, he was ordered west in 1317, defeated Tudie Temur at Shilata'er Mashi, received rich rewards, and remained in that region for fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 天曆二年，賜金符，授昭勇大將軍、同知大都督府事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli he was granted the golden tally and appointed Zhaoyong General and Associate Administrator of the Metropolitan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In 1329 he received the golden tally and was appointed Zhaoyong General and Associate Administrator of the Metropolitan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 脫因納

translations.literal: Tuoyinna
translations.idiomatic: Tuoyinna

sentences.zh: 有子曰定童、只兒哈朗。

translations.literal: He had sons Dingtong and Zhierhalang.
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons, Dingtong and Zhierhalang.

sentences.zh: 定童襲父職，阿兒魯萬戶府襄陽萬戶府漢軍達魯花赤，佩金虎符，明威將軍。

translations.literal: Dingtong inherited his father's post, darughachi of the Han army of the Xiangyang Ten-thousand Household Office under the Arlu Ten-thousand Household Office, wore the golden tiger tally, and was Mingwei General.
translations.idiomatic: Dingtong inherited his father's post as Mingwei General and darughachi of the Han forces of the Xiangyang Ten-thousand Household under the Arlu Ten-thousand Household Office, bearing the golden tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 只兒哈朗，初授欽察親軍千戶所達魯花赤，佩金符，武略將軍。

translations.literal: Zhierhalang at first was appointed darughachi of the Qipchaq Imperial Guard thousand-household office, wore the golden tally, and was Wulue General.
translations.idiomatic: Zhierhalang was first made Wulue General and darughachi of the Qipchaq Imperial Guard thousand-household office with the golden tally.

sentences.zh: 改授朝列大夫、通政院副使，歷同知，陞院使，積官中奉大夫。

translations.literal: He was changed to Chaolie dafu and Vice Minister of the Communications Office, passed through associate administrator, was raised to Director, and through accumulated offices reached Zhongfeng dafu.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Chaolie dafu and Vice Minister of the Communications Office, served as associate administrator, rose to Director, and eventually reached Zhongfeng dafu through accumulated promotions.

sentences.zh: 和尚，蒙古乃蠻台氏。

translations.literal: Heshang, of the Mongol Naimantai clan.
translations.idiomatic: Heshang was of the Mongol Naimantai clan.

sentences.zh: 祖海速，充昔烈木千戶所蒙古軍百戶。

translations.literal: His grandfather Haisu served as a hundred-household of the Mongol army in the Xiliemu thousand-household office.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Haisu was a hundred-household in the Mongol forces of the Xiliemu thousand-household office.

sentences.zh: 伯父兀魯不花，初充蒙古軍五十戶。

translations.literal: His uncle Ulubuhua at first served as a fifty-household in the Mongol army.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Ulubuhua first served as a fifty-household in the Mongol army.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，從昔烈木千戶南征，以功命權百戶，從僉省阿剌海牙攻樊城。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan he followed the Xiliemu thousand-household on the southern campaign; for merit he was ordered as acting hundred-household and followed Vice Secretariat Alahaiya in attacking Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In 1270 he followed the Xiliemu thousand-household south, was made acting hundred-household for his merit, and joined Vice Secretariat Alahaiya in the assault on Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從攻新城，又從攻鄂東門，攻處州，屢立戰功。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he followed in attacking Xincheng, again followed in attacking the east gate of E, attacked Chuzhou, and repeatedly established battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 he took part in the assaults on Xincheng, the east gate of Ezhou, and Chuzhou, distinguishing himself repeatedly in battle.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，賜銀符，授敦武校尉、後衛親軍百戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was granted the silver tally and appointed Dunwu Weiwei and hundred-household of the Rear Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 he received the silver tally and was appointed Dunwu Weiwei and hundred-household of the Rear Guard.

sentences.zh: 是年秋卒。

translations.literal: That autumn he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died that autumn.

sentences.zh: 父怯烈吉襲。

translations.literal: His father Qielieji succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His father Qielieji succeeded to the post.

sentences.zh: 怯烈吉卒，和尚襲。

translations.literal: Qielieji died; Heshang succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Qielieji died, Heshang succeeded.
